web_evidence.title: The Distributed Proofreaders Canada eBook of On the Beach, by Nevil Shute
web_evidence.note: The complete public-domain Canadian ebook was inspected at the opening and multiple interior and late-book locations. It consistently narrates Peter, Mary, Dwight, Moira, John, and others externally while entering their thoughts; no participating narrator or sustained alternative-person section appears.

person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating third person, with omniscient or shifting focal access to several characters. Diagnostic Goodreads passages q00617, q00620, q00624, and q00628 agree with the complete-text evidence and Gale's explicit structural description. The apparent first-person event quotations q00611, q00613, q00615, and q00627 were verified in the full text as clipped character dialogue, not autonomous first-person narration; q00616 is Eliot's epigraph. No credible evidence of sustained first- or second-person base sections was found. The main residual limitation is that most supplied quotes are dialogue, but complete-book web coverage resolves that sparsity.
